settings.title: K5 Vehicle Integration
settings.description: Enables climate, seats, vehicle information, radio, Comfort and CarPlay volume/media popup replacement. Keeps native popups outside CarPlay.

settings.title: Seat Ventilation Immediate Feedback (Experimental)
settings.description: Echo requested ventilation characteristics immediately, then reconcile with confirmed vehicle feedback. Off waits for BCM confirmation. Requires K5 Vehicle Integration.

settings.title: CarPlay Ultra
settings.description: Enables the consolidated Ultra capabilities, virtual cluster, DBX variant, extended features, LIVI display metadata and receiver version 950.7.1.

settings.title: Enable Ultra Sidebars
settings.description: Enables theme identity, CarPlayStartSession and themed display IDs for native vehicle apps and Ultra sidebars. Requires CarPlay Ultra.

settings.title: UI Synchronization
settings.description: Enables Ultra layout and palette synchronization. Requires Ultra Sidebars. Theme selector remains experimental.

settings.title: Force Theme Wallpaper (Experimental)
settings.description: Requests the theme's center Wallpaper layout with its supported blue palette once at UI Sync initialization. Requires UI Synchronization and Ultra Sidebars. Off restores phone-managed layouts.

settings.title: SiriusXM Discovery
settings.description: Advertises an experimental SiriusXM source with OEM catalog and eligible channel tuning. Requires vehicle validation; no entitlement changes.

settings.title: Parked AirPlay Video & Audio
settings.description: Experimental video with sound while safely parked. Stops when Park confirmation is lost.

settings.title: AirPlay Picture Only (Diagnostic)
settings.description: Disables the local AirPlay audio renderer from the start to isolate video decoding and rendering. Requires Parked AirPlay Video & Audio. All Park safety checks remain active.
